items.title: The neocloud shakeout is coming, and Nvidia has the most to lose
items.summary: After stock crashes and Firmus's scrapped IPO, industry executives expect only seven to ten of the hundreds of AI cloud providers to survive. CoreWeave lost a quarter of its market value, and Microsoft pulled out of a deal with Nscale for 23,000 Nvidia chips. Nvidia has a lot riding on the outcome, since customers outside the hyperscalers make up 45 percent of its data center revenue. The article The neocloud shakeout is coming, and Nvidia has the most to lose appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 在股價崩跌與 Firmus 的首次公開募股（IPO）取消後，業界高層預期數百家 AI 雲端供應商中，最終只有七到十家能存續。CoreWeave 市值蒸發了四分之一，微軟 則退出了一筆向 Nscale 採購 23,000 個輝達晶片的交易。輝達對此結果至關重要，因為大型雲端服務商以外的客戶佔其資料中心營收的 45%。這篇題為「新雲端（neocloud）洗牌即將到來，而輝達損失最慘重」的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: Anthropic cushions its upcoming IPO with a discretionary fund for workers its models might replace
items.summary: Anthropic wants to put five percent of its shares into a new public benefit fund that will also look into direct payments to workers at risk of losing their jobs. The fund is a company-owned LLC, so Anthropic keeps control of it as a possible IPO approaches. By offering the option of direct payments, Anthropic goes further than its competitors. Elon Musk says on X the company should just give the shares directly to the public. The article Anthropic cushions its upcoming IPO with a discretionary fund for workers its models might replace appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 希望將百分之五的股份投入一個新的公眾利益基金，該基金也將研究直接發放款項給面臨失業風險的勞工。此基金為公司旗下的有限責任公司（LLC），因此隨著可能的 IPO 臨近，Anthropic 仍保留對其的控制權。透過提供直接發放款項的選項，Anthropic 比其競爭對手走得更遠。伊隆·馬斯克（Elon Musk）在 X 上表示，該公司應該直接將股份分發給大眾。這篇題為「Anthropic 以針對可能被其模型取代之勞工的自由裁量基金，為即將到來的 IPO 鋪路」的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: G7將舉行AI網路攻擊演練，檢驗金融業應變能力

items.summary: 近期全球記憶體價格大幅飆漲，讓整個消費性電子與 PC 產業都面臨成本攀升與漲價壓力。照理來說，終端售價變貴應該會讓買家退而求其次、選擇入門規格，但 NVIDIA 個人運算業務資深副總裁 Jeff Fisher 卻透露，從 RTX Spark 的早期需求指標來看，市場買氣反而高度集中在 64GB 與 128GB 統一記憶體的最高階配置版本。

items.summary: Mistral released Timestral, a time series foundation model family from 5M to 209M parameters. The 209M model leads GIFT-Eval, TIME and fev-bench among zero-shot models and runs on CPU. The post Mistral AI Releases Timestral: A 209M Forecasting Model Family That Outperforms Google’s TimesFM-3 appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Mistral 推出了 Timestral，這是一個參數規模從 500 萬到 2.09 億的時間序列基礎模型系列。其中 2.09 億參數的模型在零樣本模型中領先了 GIFT-Eval、TIME 和 fev-bench，並且能在 CPU 上運行。這篇題為 Mistral AI Releases Timestral: A 209M Forecasting Model Family That Outperforms Google’s TimesFM-3 的文章最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items.title: llm-echo 0.5
items.summary: Release: llm-echo 0.5 I'm working towards a new LLM release, and testing PRs caused me to revisit the llm-echo debug plugin. This plugin provides a "model" which doesn't involve an LLM at all - it just repeats back the prompts that have been fed to it. The new release now updates the simulated token usage counts to take tool calls, system prompts, and reasoning tokens into account. Example usage: uvx --with llm-echo llm -m echo 'hi there' -o thinking 1 --usage Outputs: First I consider the prompt, then I decide what to say. { "prompt": "hi there", "system": "", "attachments": [], "stream": true, "previous": [] } Token usage: 2 input, 24 output Tags: llm
items.summary_zh: 版本發布：llm-echo 0.5 我正在努力推進新的 LLM 版本，而測試 PR 促使我重新檢視 llm-echo 偵錯外掛程式。這個外掛程式提供了一個完全不涉及 LLM 的「模型」——它只是重複輸入給它的提示詞。新版本現在更新了模擬的權杖（token）使用計數，將工具呼叫、系統提示詞和推理權杖納入考量。使用範例：uvx --with llm-echo llm -m echo 'hi there' -o thinking 1 --usage 輸出：First I consider the prompt, then I decide what to say. { "prompt": "hi there", "system": "", "attachments": [], "stream": true, "previous": [] } Token usage: 2 input, 24 output 標籤：llm

items_ai.title: Anthropic cushions its upcoming IPO with a discretionary fund for workers its models might replace
items_ai.summary: Anthropic wants to put five percent of its shares into a new public benefit fund that will also look into direct payments to workers at risk of losing their jobs. The fund is a company-owned LLC, so Anthropic keeps control of it as a possible IPO approaches. By offering the option of direct payments, Anthropic goes further than its competitors. Elon Musk says on X the company should just give the shares directly to the public. The article Anthropic cushions its upcoming IPO with a discretionary fund for workers its models might replace appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: Anthropic 希望將百分之五的股份投入一個新的公眾利益基金，該基金也將研究直接發放款項給面臨失業風險的勞工。此基金為公司旗下的有限責任公司（LLC），因此隨著可能的 IPO 臨近，Anthropic 仍保留對其的控制權。透過提供直接發放款項的選項，Anthropic 比其競爭對手走得更遠。伊隆·馬斯克（Elon Musk）在 X 上表示，該公司應該直接將股份分發給大眾。這篇題為「Anthropic 以針對可能被其模型取代之勞工的自由裁量基金，為即將到來的 IPO 鋪路」的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: llm-echo 0.5
items_ai.summary: Release: llm-echo 0.5 I'm working towards a new LLM release, and testing PRs caused me to revisit the llm-echo debug plugin. This plugin provides a "model" which doesn't involve an LLM at all - it just repeats back the prompts that have been fed to it. The new release now updates the simulated token usage counts to take tool calls, system prompts, and reasoning tokens into account. Example usage: uvx --with llm-echo llm -m echo 'hi there' -o thinking 1 --usage Outputs: First I consider the prompt, then I decide what to say. { "prompt": "hi there", "system": "", "attachments": [], "stream": true, "previous": [] } Token usage: 2 input, 24 output Tags: llm
items_ai.summary_zh: 版本發布：llm-echo 0.5 我正在努力推進新的 LLM 版本，而測試 PR 促使我重新檢視 llm-echo 偵錯外掛程式。這個外掛程式提供了一個完全不涉及 LLM 的「模型」——它只是重複輸入給它的提示詞。新版本現在更新了模擬的權杖（token）使用計數，將工具呼叫、系統提示詞和推理權杖納入考量。使用範例：uvx --with llm-echo llm -m echo 'hi there' -o thinking 1 --usage 輸出：First I consider the prompt, then I decide what to say. { "prompt": "hi there", "system": "", "attachments": [], "stream": true, "previous": [] } Token usage: 2 input, 24 output 標籤：llm
